verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q (Corrosive Charge) and E (Disdain) on cooldown-less trades; you win if you force all-ins the second Purge is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Urgot wins at range by poking with Q (Corrosive Charge) and punishing engages with E (Disdain), but has zero escape once that E is down and his W (Purge) timer isn't ready. Volibear's whole game is closing the gap during that dead window with E (Sky Splitter) and Q (Thundering Smash) before Urgot can reset the exchange. The 45.1% head-to-head over 133 games confirms this is a real 50/50 execution fight, not a lane Volibear is favored in.

theirWindow.when: E (Disdain) and Q (Corrosive Charge) both up
theirWindow.what: Urgot can poke with Q from 800 range and still has E ready to shield through your approach or fling you away if you commit. Don't walk into Q poke here; hold your E (Sky Splitter) rather than burning it into a shield he can just eat with.

yourWindow.when: Urgot just used E (Disdain) to engage or escape
yourWindow.what: E (Disdain) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — the moment it's down, Urgot has no way to create space. Land E (Sky Splitter) to slow him, then close with Q (Thundering Smash) for the stun; he cannot avoid the follow-up trade.

playing.title: Track Disdain, not Purge
playing.detail: E (Disdain) at 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s is the only tool that lets Urgot disengage or punish your approach. Every all-in should start the second you see it used or whiffed.

playing.title: Hold E (Sky Splitter) for commitment
playing.detail: Don't throw Sky Splitter just to poke — Urgot's E (Disdain) shield can absorb it for free. Save it to slow him the moment his escape is down.

playing.title: Avoid open Q (Corrosive Charge) lanes
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge has 800 range and slows on explosion; standing in open lane without minion cover during levels 1-5 just feeds him free poke damage.

playing.title: W (Frenzied Maul) for the double-tap heal
playing.detail: Landing W twice on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you — use this to offset Urgot's poke whenever you trade in minion-heavy waves.

playing.title: Respect Purge once it's near 0s cooldown
playing.detail: By level 11-15 Purge's cooldown drops toward 0s, letting Urgot unload repeatedly. Don't facetank extended trades in this window — commit fast with Q stun or back off.

playing.title: Save R (Stormbringer) for the reset, not the opener
playing.detail: Stormbringer's bonus Health and tower-disable are best used to re-engage after Urgot tries to walk away with Disdain on cooldown, not as your first action.

playing.title: Play around Ignite timers
playing.detail: With Ignite equipped, commit all-ins only when you can land Q stun into W into Ignite in one sequence — Urgot has no heal to answer true damage over time.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade timing is our own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (P) and (E). Use [E] to contest lane and close in with [Q] once Urgot’s abilities are on cooldown.
